title: Evaluation via required signs on the support
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates, with no coordinate appearing more than once, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. The term evaluates to $-1$ at $x$ if and only if, at every coordinate in the support of $T$, the sign of $x$ equals the sign required by the literal at that coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates with distinct coordinates
